newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-QPR SIGN SPENCER FROM CHELSEA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-QPR SIGN SPENCER FROM CHELSEA.

text.p: Scotland striker John Spencer joined London side Queens Park Rangers from neighbours Chelsea for 2.5 million pounds ($4.2 million) on Thursday.
Spencer was Chelsea's top scorer with 13 premier league goals last season but has since lost his place to Italy's Gianluca Vialli, who joined Ruud Gullit's side in the summer.
The arrival of Vialli's compatriot Gianfranco Zola has increased the pressure for first team places, prompting Spencer to move to first division QPR.
